visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a young woman in blue-and-white striped pajamas standing in a bright living room. She rubs her eyes and yawns. Above her, white text "Wave your finger!" appears. The background features a sofa, a floor lamp, and green plants. (2) In a quick transition, the woman appears in a white off-the-shoulder top and denim shorts, yawning again while sitting on the floor to put on white sneakers. The camera uses a medium-full shot to capture her outfit change. (3) Close-up shots show the woman touching her cheeks and looking at her reflection with a dissatisfied expression, indicating skin concerns. She points to her cheek. The lighting is soft and even. (4) She sits at a wooden table with several skincare product boxes. She gestures towards the products and speaks directly to the camera. Her facial expressions are animated and friendly. (5) A close-up reveals a silver cylindrical serum bottle labeled "AQUAMAX". The woman holds it up, pointing to the label. White text "AQUAMAX 激光安瓶" overlays the bottom of the frame. (6) The camera focuses on her hands as she pumps a clear liquid from the serum bottle onto her palm. She then applies the serum to her face, massaging it into her cheeks and forehead with her fingertips. (7) After application, her skin appears noticeably more radiant. She smiles and touches her glowing skin. Overlays emphasize skin qualities like "皮膚細緻" (fine skin). (8) She introduces a red and white mask package labeled "Exorigin". She is seen applying the sheet mask to her face. Subsequent shots show her wearing the mask while reading a book and using a phone. (9) The final scene shows her holding both the serum and the mask pack. Her skin looks bright and healthy. She winks and smiles brightly, giving a recommendation with a thumbs-up motion.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy, upbeat electronic background music with a strong percussive beat and synth melodies. There are no vocals. Two distinct "whoosh" sound effects mark the visual transitions between the woman's different outfits. (2) A female voice enters with a friendly and clear tone, speaking in Traditional Chinese. She explains the consequences of staying up late for her skin. The music continues at the same tempo (~122 BPM). Short "ding" sound effects coincide with the appearance of text overlays on the screen. (3) The speaker transitions to describing the benefits of the "AQUAMAX" serum. Her voice is well-enunciated and expressive. The interplay between her speech and the BGM is balanced, with the music sitting clearly in the background without masking her words. (4) The narration shifts focus to the "Exorigin" mask. The vocal arousal remains positive and energetic. A mechanical "click" sound is heard when the serum pump is depressed. The audio production is clean, exhibiting a high signal-to-noise ratio typical of a studio recording. (5) The video concludes with the speaker's final recommendation. Her tone is assertive and enthusiastic. The music reaches its final phrase and fades out quickly as the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote skincare products from AQUAMAX and Exorigin by highlighting their efficacy in repairing skin that has become dull due to sleep deprivation. It combines a personal story about staying up late with a step-by-step product demonstration and a final enthusiastic endorsement to persuade viewers of the brand's value.
